notes.title: PLAY HEPTIC ARENA AT PLAYCON MALTA 2025
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome Contenders,[/h2][p]Just two months after showcasing our Early Alpha build at Gamescom, we are thrilled to announce that Heptic Arena will be playable at Playcon 2025 in Malta from the 9th to the 12th of October! [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate this announcement, we're releasing 3 brand new screenshots that showcase the phases of the galaxy's deadliest Game Show: Quest Gathering, PvPvE Combat, and Relic Extraction.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/912875b9205672aea3438c8ba81f60a68e35b4e4.jpg"][/img][b]GRAB YOUR QUEST[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/c57b81595c739a49890699570e433d8f527aa9e1.jpg"][/img][b]COMPLETE YOUR QUESTS[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/e2af6244fa8922de2afb6cb0516ac23ab5178b1d.jpg"][/img][b]GRAB THE RELIC AND GET TO THE ARENA![/b][/p][p][/p][p]For Heptic Arena, which is currently in Early Alpha, opportunities like these are crucial for us to gather every piece of feedback possible to help us make Heptic Arena the chaotic PvPvE experience it is intended to be. At Playcon, players will experience an updated version from Gamescom, featuring small fixes and tweaks based on community feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to see you at Playcon! Until then, check out Heptic Arena’s Trailer here and hop into our Discord to join the community, share your ideas, and help shape the future of Heptic Arena.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/e4fd8d43111853c2d5c96874c67e5be337f27fa5.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nTfUGUEMVeo"]Click Here[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/6afc6d795c6987860ffd859ccd8c6c8338acbc89.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/heptic"]Click Here[/url][/p][h3]
Wishlist on Steam[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707850/Heptic_Arena/"][/dynamiclink][i]Special thanks to Gaming Malta for supporting our presence at PlayCon 2025.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Heptic Arena is developed by Prism Studio, founded in Malta in 2022, which makes us extra excited to see local players enjoying the game.[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: GAMESCOM TRAILER NOW LIVE
notes.content:
[h2]Contenders, the time has come![/h2][p][/p][p]Our brand new Gamescom Teaser Trailer is now live with the first official look at the heart-pounding gameplay, unique art style, and captivating universe of Heptic Arena. [/p][p]We've been working tirelessly to bring this vision to life, and we are thrilled to finally share a glimpse of the intense PvPvE action that awaits you. This teaser is a culmination of our efforts and provides a sneak peek into the world we're building, setting the stage for what you can expect when you step into the arena yourself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/e13bc5c7842ceb6d27d3e4137ce6ca09fcf0ce80.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition, we've added a bunch of new things to our Steam page, featuring:[/p][list][*][p]Brand new screenshots showcasing the intense PvPvE action and the diversity of the arena[/p][/*][*][p]More detailed information on gameplay, features, and support[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Click here to visit the Heptic Arena Steam page and Wishlist us today:[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707850/Heptic_Arena/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Wishlisting us is the best way to support our development and stay notified of all major updates, future playtests, and the official release. Every wishlist makes a huge difference.[/p][p][/p][h1]Gamescom 2025[/h1][p]As a reminder, we will be at Gamescom 2025! Come see us in person in Hall 10.1 B078 - C079 to play the first public early alpha and meet the development team. If you can't make it to Gamescom, we have you covered. We'll be hosting a special live stream on the Steam page featuring the world premiere of a full round of Heptic Arena gameplay. Tune in on Wednesday, August 20th, and make sure you're following our Steam page to get notified the second we go live![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/3b3c4ab9d8cf981c7ce17e479759ebf8a2855e3a.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible support on this journey. We're building something truly special, and we're thrilled to have you with us.[/p][p][/p][h3]See you in the Arena![/h3][h2][b]The Heptic Arena Team[/b][/h2][p]
[/p]

notes.title: WORLD FIRST PUBLIC PLAYABLE AT GAMESCOM 2025
notes.content: [h2][b]Greetings, Contenders![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The wait is almost over. We are incredibly excited to announce that the Heptic Arena Early Alpha will be publicly playable for the very first time at [b]Gamescom 2025[/b] in [b]Cologne[/b], Germany![/p][p][/p][p]This is the moment we've all been working towards—a chance for you, our community, to finally get your hands on the game and experience the high-octane, glitched-out combat you've been waiting for. Your feedback is crucial as we approach our launch, and we look forward to seeing you dominate the arena in person.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/3b3c4ab9d8cf981c7ce17e479759ebf8a2855e3a.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Find Us in Hall 10.1 B078 - C079![/b][/h1][p]Mark your maps and set your coordinates! You'll be able to find us at our massive [b]Heptic Arena booth[/b] located in [b]Hall 10.1 B078 - C079[/b]. We’ll be there for the entire duration of Gamescom and open to the public from August 20th to August 24th. Say hello to the development team, challenge your friends, and showcase your skills. We're ready for you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/5bd5edd12be73ac83f31bb925efd86d9a4fbbd78.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Exclusive Merch & Giveaways![/b][/h1][p]It wouldn't be a proper celebration without some epic loot. We'll be giving away a ton of exclusive goodies and Heptic Arena swag throughout the event! What kind of goodies, you ask? You'll have to follow our social channels for the big reveals![/p][p]We’ll be announcing the exclusive items in the days and weeks leading up to Gamescom. Make sure you’re following us so you don’t miss out:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/KXhnd3GDNV"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/heptic/"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@hepticplay"]YouTube[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/hepticarena"]Facebook[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/playheptic"]X[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44770155/194da3886e903d26511533080be92b249f9eb0f7.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Can't make it to Gamescom? We've Got You Covered![/b] [/h1][p]We know that not everyone can make the trip to Cologne, but don't worry—you are a massive part of our community, and we won't let you miss the action.[/p][p][/p][p]First, make sure you are following the Heptic Arena Steam Page. In the run-up to Gamescom, we will be dropping a massive amount of new content right here — including [b]new screenshots[/b], [b]lore details[/b], and behind-the-scenes looks at development.[/p][p][/p][p]On [b]Wednesday, August 19th[/b], we will kick off a special broadcast. This [b]pre-recorded stream[/b] will feature the WORLD PREMIERE of a full round of [b]Heptic Arena gameplay[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]So, follow us here on Steam and add the game to your Wishlist to be notified the second we go live and when we post any new updates![/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re joining us in Cologne or tuning in from home, we are thrilled to share this huge milestone with you all. Get ready for the mayhem![/p][p][/p][p][i]See you in the Arena.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][b]The Heptic Arena Dev Team[/b][/p][p][/p]
